result.summary: Fixes the Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking. It passes the intended mixed-weight coin pool instead of the default pool and lowers the maximum selection weight so that coin eviction is required to succeed.
result.problem: The unit test introduced in PR 33223 failed to actually test SRD weight tie-breaking because it passed the wrong UTXO pool and allowed a maximum weight large enough that eviction never occurred. A regression in the tie-break logic could pass existing unit and functional tests undetected.
evidence: Author demonstrates that reverting the SRD tie-break fix from PR 33223 on master still results in 20/20 test passes in coinselection_tests/srd_test, whereas under this PR reverting it correctly fails 20/20 runs (PR description).
result.card: This PR fixes the Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection unit test to verify that equal-value coin evictions correctly tie-break by weight. The existing test added in PR 33223 passed the wrong UTXO pool variable and configured an overly permissive maximum weight, allowing the test to pass even if the tie-breaking logic was completely removed. Reverting the original tie-break fix on master still passes 20 of 20 test runs, while with this test update it reliably fails 20 of 20 runs. The change affects only test code and has no open dependencies.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause a false positive or false negative in a coin selection unit test without affecting production wallet behavior.
